prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1366; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache. Over the course of twenty visits, care consisted of supervised physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, manual therapy, and home exercise instruction. Cervical examination revealed reduced range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness consistent with soft tissue injury, while certain neurological screening tests, including reflexes, strength, and sensation, returned normal results. The mechanism and force of the collision align well with the injury pattern described. No prior injury or treatment involving the cervical spine is known. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and range of motion returned closer to baseline. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. Patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
